scope: Optional held-out checks inside training; supplied-mask linking only

behavior.cadence: Initial check, each len(training_pairs) sampled updates by default, and each stage end; explicit positive update interval supported. Weighted sampling epochs need not see every unique pair.
behavior.holdout: Reject resolved movie aliases in CLI and exact canonical float32 three-channel input overlap across either endpoint. No near-duplicate detection.
behavior.state: Restore module modes, head weights/buffers, CPU and selected CUDA RNG; do not touch optimizer or gradients.
behavior.persistence: Exclusive JSONL report creation before model construction; flush configuration and checks; completion event only after model and metadata saves.
behavior.provenance: Input fingerprints, mask source, matching policy/thresholds and model/scoring source hashes. Validation disabled explicitly in metadata for legacy calls.

validation.training_equivalence: Five real tiny-Torch optimizer updates with dropout produce identical losses and final state with and without held-out validation.
validation.cuda_scope: Routing only mocked, no actual GPU execution.

cached_score_compatibility.scope: Scoring refactor only; completed cache records at audit time, no repeat inference or new model-performance claim.

limitations: No new trained checkpoint, real biological held-out accuracy or model promotion.
Initial head is not necessarily untrained when resuming a model; its encoder is the current encoder.
Exact input separation is not biological independence or annotation quality validation.
Model-own segmentation, whole-movie lineage/stable IDs and corrected production training remain open.
Live old/new matching comparison uses its already-imported source235ef07ea and is not restarted.
